package reporting

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestProgress(t *testing.T) {
	progress()
}

func TestSubtests(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("first", func(t *testing.T) { progress() })
	t.Run("second", func(t *testing.T) { progress() })
}

func TestSkip(t *testing.T) {
	progress()
	t.Skip("fixture skip")
}

func TestFailure(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("REPORTING_FIXTURE_FAIL") != "1" {
		t.Skip("failure mode disabled")
	}
	progress()
	t.Fatal("fixture failure must remain visible")
}
